void-black.$description: Void Black — Page background, nav background, footer — the base layer everything sits on

deep-charcoal.$description: Deep Charcoal — Card surfaces, elevated sections sitting one level above Void Black

gunmetal.$description: Gunmetal — Dividers, secondary borders, subtle panel edges

graphite.$description: Graphite — Tertiary surface, hover states on dark cards

steel.$description: Steel — Inactive icons, secondary UI strokes, muted borders

pewter.$description: Pewter — Ghost button borders, subtle rule lines

slate.$description: Slate — Tertiary text, nav dropdown labels, disabled states

ash.$description: Ash — Secondary body text, caption-level descriptions

fog.$description: Fog — Footer text, body copy, icon fills — the primary readable text color on dark surfaces

silver.$description: Silver — Outlined button borders, slightly elevated muted text

cloud.$description: Cloud — Divider lines in lighter contexts, high-contrast borders

white.$description: White — Primary headings, button text, nav labels, high-emphasis body copy

signal-blue.$description: Signal Blue — Primary CTA buttons, active nav indicators, links — single chromatic anchor in an achromatic field, impossible to miss

deep-signal.$description: Deep Signal — Info/announcement badges — darker blue variant for label-scale elements

map-green.$description: Map Green — Success and 'Product Update' badge backgrounds — cartographic green signals new features

cera-pro.$description: All text on the site — nav, headings, body, badges, buttons. Weight 700 at 44–68px for hero headlines with -0.02em tracking that compresses letterforms into coordinate-grid density. Weight 500 for subheadings and UI labels. Weight 400 for body copy and captions. The geometric construction of Cera Pro — circular O, monoline strokes — echoes the precision circles of map pin iconography.
